crossRefs.note: Jeshua became the father of Joiakim, and Joiakim became the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib became the father of…
and Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.
In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’ households: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

people.name: Darius
people.line: Persian Emperor during the time of the Levites

people.name: Eliashib
people.line: High priest, father of Joiada and ancestor of Jaddua

people.name: Jaddua
people.line: High priest during the time of Alexander the Great.

people.name: Johanan
people.line: A high priest during the Persian period

people.name: Joiada
people.line: A high priest, son of Eliashib

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Persia
people.line: An empire that ruled over the exiled Jews

translations.web: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers’ households; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.
translations.bsb: In the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, during the reign of Darius the Persian, the heads of the families of the Levites and priests were recorded.
translations.kjv: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.
translations.asv: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers' houses; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.
